## Summary

<!-- What changes and why, in one or two sentences. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` new functionality
- [ ] `fix` bug fix
- [ ] `docs` documentation only
- [ ] `test` tests only
- [ ] `refactor` / `chore` no behaviour change

## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` passes (ruff, mypy, pytest) or the equivalent `uv run` commands
- [ ] New public functions have type hints and NumPy-style docstrings
- [ ] New numerical behaviour is covered by a test with an analytical or reference oracle
- [ ] Any number quoted in docs or slides comes from code that was run (no hand-typed results)
- [ ] Generated outputs (`data/`, `results/`, `deck/build/`) are not committed
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
